'''Pong Krell's lightsabers''' were constructed and used by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Pong Krell/Legends|Pong Krell]] during the galaxy wide conflict known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
[[File:PongKrell-SWE.png|thumb|left|250px|[[Pong Krell/Legends|Pong Krell]] wielding his lightsabers]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Pong Krell/Legends|Pong Krell]] used these [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] in the battles that he fought in, most notably in the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]] c. [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], which was a costly victory for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. These lightsabers were unique as they could fold at the middle, so that they could be clipped to Krell's [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] utility belt. Seeing a double bladed lightsaber was rather rare in this time period, which made Krell one of the few Jedi within the Order to wield double-bladed lightsabers, and more notably, two twin versions.

The lightsaber's massive size and the low pitched 'buzzing' sound it made when it was swung suggests it would qualify for the category of [[lightclub]], which was a much larger version of the standard lightsaber. Another notable wielder of a single bladed lightclub was the dark Jedi [[Gorc]].

The lightsabers could be activated whilst in the folded position as shown when General Krell countered [[Fives/Legends|Fives's]] insubordination with the blade. During the Battle of Umbara, the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] under his command discovered that General Krell was secretly sabotaging the Republic effort in an attempt to appease the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Dooku/Legends|Darth Tyranus]] after foreseeing the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] and [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. The 501st and [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]] joined forces and immediately set out to capture the former Jedi, and when they caught up with him, they managed to disarm him of one of his lightsabers for a short time before he regained it. He wielded his dual double-bladed lightsabers with deadly precision, spinning them like buzz saws for devastating effect and was capable of easily defending himself against the clone troopers of the elite legion. Although he was undermined by his own overconfidence and the ingenuity of Trooper Tup, Krell easily massacred scores of clones with a combination of deadly lightsaber techniques. Krell used his lightsabers against a [[Vixus/Legends|vixus]], but was stunned, arrested, and eventually shot to death by [[Dogma/Legends|Dogma]].
